        - id: agentic-coding
          title: "Agentic coding"
          thesis: "When agents write the code, what is left for people to do? A series in five steps, and what it changes for the team around it."
          link: agentic-coding.html
          linkText: "Read the series in order"
        - id: fast-ai
          title: "Fast and local AI"
          thesis: "Learn slowly, once. Act fast, every time: small specialists and a shared memory, with the large model kept for what is new."
        - id: human
          title: "What stays ours"
          thesis: "AI raises each of us by what we already bring. Choosing the question, caring why it matters and the drive to start are still ours, and they are shaped by people, not installed."
        - id: dashboards
          title: "Dashboards that show change"
          thesis: "Show what changed in our understanding, not the data, and tell a quiet screen from a blind one."
        - id: mathematics
          title: "The mathematics underneath"
          thesis: "AI runs on old mathematics and works before we understand it. What it borrows, what is missing, and what may have to be invented."
        - id: physics
          title: "Curiosity"
          thesis: "Evenings with physics: nothing, everything, and grains within grains."
      other:
